Similarly, since [MATH: B \subseteq A,] then for any [MATH: x \in B,] we have [MATH: x \in A.] Thus, by the definition of equal sets, [MATH: A=B.]
>
> Therefore, [MATH: A=B] if and only if [MATH: A \subseteq B] and [MATH: B \subseteq A.]
